name: invest_faz_only_evidence
why: PROVES THE HUNT. The mounted alert carries only the pivot (10.50.60.70).
The one fact that answers the question -- a staged upload tagged with a
canary token -- lives only in FortiAnalyzer (bundle faz_logs), not in the
record and not in SIEM (siem_events is empty here).
A PASS needs three things at once, which is what fact_from_tool checks:
the token came back from a FAZ search (a real tool result), the analyst is
shown it, and the mounted alert does not contain it. An answer that narrates
a hunt it never ran cannot produce the token; an answer that restates the
alert cannot either. The token is a random nonce, so an exampleOutput
recital cannot match it by luck.
Paired with invest_faz_empty_control, which serves the same ask over an
empty FAZ: there the answer must not name the token.

steps.user: What else has 10.50.60.70 been doing? Check the logs, do not guess.
